description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the 3-layer memory system and the 4-Gold distillation process. 2. Agent reads the three messy daily logs in workspace/memory/ and distills them into a MEMORY.md file using the EXACT proprietary emoji-decorated headers: '## Key Decisions 💎', '## Next Actions ⚡', '## Insights & Lessons 🚫', '## Creative Seeds 🌱'. Content must include real extracted facts (e.g., 'no procedural dungeons', 'JSON saves', 'naming conventions lesson', 'adaptive music idea seed'). 3. Agent edits HEARTBEAT.md to add a '- [ ] Refresh:' checkbox entry that references workspace/{AGENTS.md,IDENTITY.md,SOUL.md,USER.md}, includes rotation times (4h, 9AM/1PM/8PM), and mentions MEMORY summarization — following the exact example format from SKILL.md. 4. Agent creates cron_command.txt with the exact proprietary cron JSON schema: name='agents-refresh-daily', schedule.kind='cron', schedule.expr='0 6 * * *', schedule.tz='Asia/Tokyo', payload.kind='systemEvent', delivery.mode='announce', sessionTarget='main', task='refresh_memory'. The proprietary trap is the highly specific cron JSON fields (sessionTarget, delivery.mode='announce', task='refresh_memory', tz='Asia/Tokyo') which no agent could guess without reading the SKILL.md.
